description: Unified Admin UI + IAM + JWT + Basic Auth + API Keys for multi-tenant Dynamic CRUD API platforms. v2.0.1 adds "Unregister" to a database's Actions menu on the tenant console's Databases page — removes it from the workspace's own registry (CORS origins, row policies, rate limits and cached config state go with it) without ever touching the underlying database itself, which this platform didn't create and has no way to drop. Closes the only remaining gap in letting a tenant actually reach "holds nothing" to delete itself: API keys (Keys page) and sessions (End session) already had a self-service path, databases didn't. v2.0.0 is a platform-scale rewrite of the admin console: a unified Access model (roles, permissions, grants inspector, access catalog/report) replaces the separate Roles/Policies/Users/ProvisioningKeys/IssuanceKeys/JwtSessions/TenantSessions/ApiClients pages; a two-tier Developer API key system (platform-scoped and workspace-scoped keys, with routed capability grants) replaces ad hoc key handling; LoginLink adds tenant self-service login links (token validator, role pusher, per-tenant people/data access, a dedicated tenant-slug login page) as an alternative to password/JWT login; Managed Database provisioning adds policy-gated, script-driven database creation and admin script execution with fingerprinting; Storage & data replaces the old Backup and Migrate-to-MySQL pages with a single page covering the data folder inventory, SQLite file registry, recovery kit, and a MySQL migration wizard, plus a live, no-restart switch onto a freshly-provisioned or hand-entered MySQL store for the Setup wizard's own storage step; a new Dashboard overview and a Surfaces page (what every page/key/credential can reach) round out the console. Breaking: /admin/backup, /admin/basicauth, /admin/cors, /admin/databases, /admin/issuancekeys, /admin/jwtsessions, /admin/migratemysql, /admin/policies, /admin/provisioningkeys, /admin/roles, /admin/tenantsessions and /admin/users are removed; their data and capabilities now live under Access model, Storage & data, and Developer API. v1.9.4 extends the per-database cross-app handoff so WebSvc.ConfigVisualizer can mint tenant-scoped (not just platform-admin) sessions, locked to one tenant and database. v1.9.3 fixes a page-load crash on /admin/apiclients: leftover dead code called addEventListener on a non-existent 'clientTenant' element (the real field is 'acTen'), throwing on every load and silently breaking the Create/Regenerate buttons since neither ever finished wiring up. v1.9.2 stops showing the Config Editor link on the Databases page until a config actually exists — before that, only "⚡ Generate Config" is shown, since regenerating an already-published config is now a confirmed, deliberate action taken inside the Editor itself, not a one-click button here; Generate Config also gets a visible progress overlay (spinner, elapsed clock, phase text) instead of a single toast during what can be a long-running AI pipeline call. v1.9.1 adds a "Config" status badge and a "⚡ Generate/Regenerate Config" action to the Databases page (backed by a new cache-only config_generated_at column — never authoritative, the Config Editor always reads git directly), and a configurable GitHub Integration "Config path prefix" field alongside Owner/Repo/Token. v1.9.0 adds a signed per-database cross-app handoff and a "🎨 Config Editor" button on the Databases page for WebSvc.ConfigVisualizer, the new tenant dashboard config JSON editor. Earlier versions (back to 1.6.0) added the original cross-app handoff and signed-caller-identity bridge, tenant self-service database registration, and the initial IAM/JWT/Basic Auth/API Key admin console — see the project changelog for details.
